# Requirements Document: Payment status and paid items

## Introduction

A payment's status follows from the transactions of its payment methods, and
an order item counts as paid once a successful payment covers it.  The airline
records each method's outcome as it learns it.

These requirements are generated from the Lean model in [`Rules/OneOrder/Payment/Status.lean`](https://github.com/samdengler/verified-air/blob/main/Rules/OneOrder/Payment/Status.lean). Each acceptance criterion carries the status the build computed for it: *proven* means a theorem the build checked, *example only* means a computed example, *open* means a theorem the build could not prove, and *not checked* means no theorem or example covers it yet.

## Requirements

### Requirement ONE-301

**User Story:** As an airline, I want a payment made with several methods to succeed only when every method succeeds, so that I never treat an order item as paid when part of its money will not arrive.

**Rule:** THE SYSTEM SHALL give a payment the status FAILED if it has no payment method or the transaction of any of its payment methods failed, SUCCESSFUL if all of them succeeded, and PENDING otherwise. (Lean: `status`)

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. IF the transaction of any payment method in a payment fails THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the whole payment FAILED.
   - ONE-301.1, proven: proven theorem `status_failed_iff`; example `declinedCardForBag`; example `statusFromMethods`
2. WHEN a payment has at least one payment method and the transactions of all its payment methods succeed THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the payment SUCCESSFUL.
   - ONE-301.2, proven: proven theorem `status_successful_iff`; example `statusFromMethods`
3. WHILE no payment method's transaction in a payment has failed and at least one is still pending THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the payment PENDING.
   - ONE-301.3, proven: proven theorem `status_pending_iff`; example `statusFromMethods`
4. IF a payment has no payment method THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL mark it FAILED.
   - ONE-301.4, proven: proven theorem `status_without_method`; example `paymentWithoutMethod`

### Requirement ONE-302

**User Story:** As an airline, I want an order item counted as paid only when a payment for it has succeeded, so that I release nothing on money I may not collect.

**Rule:** THE SYSTEM SHALL count an order item paid once a SUCCESSFUL payment covers it. (Lean: `isPaid`)

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a SUCCESSFUL payment covers an order item THE SYSTEM SHALL count the item paid.
   - ONE-302.1, proven: proven theorem `isPaid_iff`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined`
2. IF every payment covering an order item is PENDING or FAILED THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL not count the item paid.
   - ONE-302.2, proven: proven theorem `isPaid_iff`; example `paymentWithoutMethod`; example `pendingRedirect`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined`
3. IF the transaction of any payment method in a payment fails THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL count none of the order items it covers as paid by that payment and shall leave their services unchanged.
   - ONE-302.3, proven: proven theorem `failed_method_pays_nothing`; example `declinedCardForBag`

### Requirement ONE-303

**User Story:** As an airline, I want the outcome of each payment method's transaction recorded as it arrives, so that a payment's status follows what I know about its funds.

**Rule:** WHEN the airline reports the outcome of a payment method's transaction THE SYSTEM SHALL record it as the transaction's status if the move from the recorded status is allowed. (Lean: `recordOutcome`)

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN the airline reports a SUCCESSFUL or FAILED outcome for a payment method's transaction that is still PENDING THE SYSTEM SHALL record the outcome.
   - ONE-303.1, proven: proven theorem `recordOutcome_pending`; example `redirectCompletes`
2. WHEN the airline reports the outcome of one payment method's transaction THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the transactions of the payment's other methods unchanged.
   - ONE-303.2, proven: proven theorem `recordOutcome_other_methods`; example `redirectCompletes`
3. THE SYSTEM SHALL never change the status of a payment that is SUCCESSFUL or FAILED.
   - ONE-303.3, open: open theorem `recordOutcome_settled_final`; counterexample `chargeback`; counterexample `lateRedirectCapture`

#### Open question on ONE-303.3

> A SUCCESSFUL or FAILED payment keeps its status whatever outcome the airline
> later reports for one of its methods.
>
> Open question for the business.  The guide says a PENDING payment moves to
> SUCCESSFUL or FAILED and does not say whether either is final.  Under a reading
> where a card chargeback turns a successful transaction into a failed one, a
> SUCCESSFUL payment becomes FAILED; the example `chargeback` shows it.
> Under a reading where a redirected payment completed after the airline marked
> it failed is recorded, a FAILED payment becomes SUCCESSFUL; the example
> `lateRedirectCapture` shows it.  Can a SUCCESSFUL payment later fail, can
> a FAILED payment later succeed, and what then happens to the order items it
> covers?
